ITEM 5 UI: progress-render-stats card shows TARGET WEIGHT 78.8 kg, EST. BODY FAT 22.4%, and the 'what it takes' line (~1.02 lb/week lose · expected path over 20 weeks). ITEM 1 regression: app launches DARK by default — Screen/Plan/Progress/Targets screenshots confirm dark surface + light text; the ESTIMATE pill overlay is a fixed neutral scrim independent of theme.
